notes: Sending a message no longer waits minutes on the undo checkpoint, and the git housekeeping that starved it is scoped and batched. send() in src/main/server/sessions.ts (and the steer, resume, continue, turn-pass and report-drain paths) awaited armCheckpoint — CheckpointStore.ensure on the store's strict per-session chain — before handle.send, so a send queued behind a slow checkpoint.status sat for 200–500 s with no row, no status and no busySince while the renderer showed only its local spinner (stalls.log: session.send 202549ms behind checkpoint.ensure 202530ms behind checkpoint.status 204785ms). Now the user-text row and a 'starting' status land before the harness boots, busySince anchors to the send, and armBaseline() runs the ensure alongside the boot: the store's chain still orders every later capture behind it, and the claude driver's new PreToolUse hook on Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash (DriverCtx.awaitBaseline) waits for the in-flight baseline so the snapshot never freezes the agent's own edit as "before" (a hook, not canUseTool, because hooks fire under bypassPermissions). A harness that fails to boot re-queues the message as echoed (QueuedSendOpts.echoed) so the retry does not duplicate the user row or lose the first-message preamble. checkpoint.ts asks HEAD once per operation (inHeadMany: one git ls-tree over every path that needs it) instead of one cat-file per touched file, and sync reads the other sessions' manifests from an in-memory index kept current by the store's own saves and drops instead of re-reading every manifest dir under the checkpoints root (2,964 on this machine) per call. The renderer's git-changed signal (lib/gitChanged.ts, re-exported from fs.ts) carries the checkout it changed: App.tsx tool-result and turn-end nudges name the session's work cwd, gitIndexStore subscribes per checkout, and SessionReview subscribes per checkout and coalesces checkpoint.status into one trailing call per 500 ms burst, so eighteen running threads no longer re-diff a 49k-file repo nobody touched after every tool call. Tests: sessions-send-baseline (send returns while ensure is held open; rows user-text → starting → running; busySince = starting.ts; the write gate waits and releases with the baseline; a steer keeps running; a failed boot echoes the row once), checkpoint-spawns (one HEAD lookup for forty files in status, ensure and capture; a capture queued behind ensure lands on its manifest; the index sees later saves), gitChanged scope, gitIndexStore scoped burst, SessionReview.dom debounce; sessions-limits' helper now settles its silent-driver threads idle, since a send marks them starting. Verified in an isolated dev instance over CDP with 48 concurrent diffs of HSSports saturating the child budget: session.send returned in 36 ms, busySince equalled the starting row's ts (2 ms after the send), and the stall log shows checkpoint.ensure in flight for 19.8 s with no slow session.send.
